user.title: Connect to Food Calc
user.description: Create a token on your household's settings page, under Plan API, then paste it here.

data_description.base_url: The address you open Food Calc at, including the http or https prefix
data_description.household_id: The number in your household's URL, for example 12 in /h/12/plan
data_description.token: The token from the household settings page. It is the whole credential, so treat it like a password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Food Calc
reauth_confirm.description: The token for household {household} is no longer accepted. It may have been revoked, or the person who created it may have left the household. Create a new one under Plan API on the household settings page and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Food Calc at that address.
error.invalid_auth: Food Calc rejected that token for that household. Check both the token and the household ID — the API deliberately does not say which one is wrong.
error.invalid_url: That is not a valid http:// or https:// address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: That household is already set up.
